1.why: All nine screens show a clean static layout with no moving images, animations, or pop-ups.

2.why: Teal primary buttons, bold headings, and highlighted notice boxes make key actions and warnings stand out.

3.why: Each screen is single-purpose with one main field and button, so the next needed action is easy to locate.

4.why: The multi-step flow plus password complexity rules (12+ chars, upper, lower, number, symbol) require remembering several items.

5.why: No password-manager hint, autofill affordance, or “remember me” option appears on any screen.

6.why: No saved credentials, familiar devices, or other recognisable prior items are displayed.

7.why: Labels and instructions are mostly short and plain-language across the screens.

8.why: No error states or error messages are shown in any of the provided screenshots.

9.why: Password rules are stated and some fields contain sample values, but concrete typed examples are limited.

10.why: Only password then MFA code are used; no clear alternative choices such as face login are offered.

11.why: Every screen presents at most two actions, avoiding choice overload.

12.why: Inline confirmations and the growing log explicitly state the outcome of each completed step.

13.why: Safe-sign-in reminders and password-requirement tips appear on the relevant new steps.

14.why: “Start over”, “Return to sign in”, and “Forgot password?” controls let the user retry after mistakes.

15.why: Header, card layout, button styles, and log panel remain visually consistent across all nine steps.
